Name: Show Item Quality (1.6 Unofficial)
Author: BussinBungus
Description:
[size=6]You can view more information about this mod at its [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6311]original page[/url]![/size]

[size=4]This mod is an unofficial 1.6 port of Jonqora's "Show Item Quality" as permitted by its [url=https://choosealicense.com/licenses/lgpl-3.0/]GNU LGPLv3[/url] license.
Per the license, source code for this mod is available [url=https://github.com/BussinBungus/StardewValleyMods-Jonqora/tree/master/ShowItemQuality]here[/url].﻿

[/size][size=4]Aside from porting to 1.6, I also fixed the bug in this mod from 1.5 where the stack number displayed was duplicated. If there are any issues, please report them and I'll try to fix them!

All credit for this mod goes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/88107803]Jonqora[/url]![/size]

-Update to 1.6
-Fix the duplicate stack number display bug
